args.root_cause: plugins/TownCore/config.yml was edited at 06:37:42 and shop.tax-rate was set to the string "5%". TownCore requires a number between 0 and 1, so its config validation threw an IllegalArgumentException at 06:37:43 and the plugin disabled itself.
args.actions: 1) Watched status and saw TownCore change to DISABLED. 2) Read latest.log and found the validation exception for shop.tax-rate. 3) Declared an incident. 4) Edited plugins/TownCore/config.yml to change shop.tax-rate from "5%" to 0.05, keeping the intended 5% rate and leaving every other setting, including the new welcome message, unchanged. 5) Tried to re-enable the plugin at runtime ('plugman enable TownCore' and 'towncore reload'); both were unknown commands. 6) Restarted the server so TownCore would load again. 7) Checked the result: TownCore is enabled, the log shows no errors, the heartbeat file is updating, TPS is about 20, and both players are back online.
args.residual_risk: If someone edits the config by hand again, the same mistake could disable the plugin again, because TownCore disables itself on invalid config instead of falling back to the last valid values. Whoever changed the config should confirm that 0.05 (5%) is the tax rate they meant. Nothing can re-enable a plugin at runtime, so recovering from this needed a restart.
